native.iol_port_mode: Actual communication or SIO/inactive mode; SIO has no UART telegram capacity.
native.iol_state: Actual data-link state; STARTUP/PREOPERATE differ from OPERATE and inactive.
native.iol_protocol_revision: Actual negotiated wire RevisionID1.0 versus1.1; old protocol needs its own legacy sequence proof.
native.iol_com_mode: Actual discovered device baud capability; baseline COM1 proposal does not change a COM3-only device.
native.iol_bitrate_bps: Actual COM-selected C/Q bitrate; upper network transport has its own clock.
native.iol_port_class: Actual class A versus electrically isolated extra power class B.
native.iol_connector: Actual connector/pin assignment; nonstandard legacy wiring needs own evidence.
native.iol_iodd_source: Actual approved IODD identifier/hash/version and process/parameter description.
native.iol_master_source: Actual master port firmware, discovery/configuration/schedule capabilities.
native.iol_physical_source: Actual cable/connector/power/CQ electrical and timing evidence.
native.iol_binding_source: Actual canonical master port and unique connected device; not whole fieldbus.
native.iol_encoding_source: Actual PD/OD/ISDU types, bit offsets/order/full M-sequence layout.
native.iol_schedule_source: Actual master cycle, device processing, recovery/retries and upper-network schedule.
native.iol_legacy_source: Actual legacy1.0 compatibility and interleaved sequence/encoding evidence.
native.iol_extra_power_source: Actual isolated Power2 connector, load/derating/current and device behavior.
native.iol_device_identity: Actual discovered vendor/device/serial identity, not default ID0.
native.iol_port_binding: Actual registered point-to-point C/Q port binding.
native.iol_device_count: Actual connected devices on this point-to-point port, not master port count.
native.iol_port_number: Actual port number in its master, no universal8-port default.
native.iol_data_bits: SDCI fixed8 UART data bits; bit transmission order distinct from multi-octet order.
native.iol_stop_bits: SDCI fixed one UART stop bit.
native.iol_character_bits: SDCI full UART start/data/parity/stop cost11 bits.
native.iol_pd_in_bits: Actual cyclic device-to-master bit length, not encoded length field.
native.iol_pd_in_length_code: Actual5-bit length code; octet coding means length+1, not direct byte count.
native.iol_od_octets: Actual on-request portion of selected M-sequence, distinct from full ISDU record.
native.iol_master_octets: Actual full Master request UART octets including MC/CKT and active PD/OD.
native.iol_device_octets: Actual full Device response UART octets including CKS and active PD/OD.
native.iol_retry_count: Specified two communication-error retries, not wake-up sequences or gateway retry policy.
native.iol_wake_retry_count: Specified two wake-up retries; total attempts include initial one.
native.iol_index: Actual parameter Index; ISDU rejects0/1, other reserved/profile-specific ranges need own evidence.
native.iol_subindex: Actual parameter subindex;0 addresses complete record.
native.iol_record_bytes: Actual device accepted record data, distinct from ISDU headers and total length.
native.iol_record_items: Actual count of elements in a parameter record.
native.iol_direct_page_octets: Actual direct parameter page width, distinct from ISDU data.
native.iol_isdu_header_bytes: Actual full encoded ISDU protocol octets for selected operation/address/length format.
native.iol_isdu_length_nibble: Actual encoded LEN:1 means extended length,2..15 short services.
native.iol_isdu_ext_length: Actual extended full ISDU length, not232-byte application record ceiling.
native.iol_event_memory_count: Actual buffered event count, independent from AL_Event indication count.
native.iol_al_event_count: Specified one event per AL_Event.req service call.
native.iol_cycle_time_base: Actual cycle code time-base bits;3 reserved.
native.iol_min_cycle_code: Actual device MinCycleTime encoded octet;0 means unavailable, not zero execution time.
native.iol_parity: SDCI fixed even UART parity, independent from checksum.
native.iol_octet_order: Protocol multioctet values most-significant octet first; own IODD bit offset rules still apply.
native.iol_serial_number: Actual identity, protocol field up to16 octets not arbitrary Unicode character count.
native.iol_serial_number_bytes: Actual StringT-encoded serial identity octets; no fabricated serial number.
native.iol_string_encoding: Actual StringT US-ASCII versus UTF-8; byte limits apply to encoded octets, not character counts.
native.iol_pd_in_unit: Actual ProcessDatain coding; bits0..16 or octets3..32.
native.iol_pd_out_unit: Actual ProcessDataout coding; bits0..16 or octets3..32.
native.iol_msequence: Actual supported sequence; formerTYPE_2_6 replaced, not accepted as current.
native.iol_channel: Actual cyclic process, direct page, ISDU or event channel.
native.iol_isdu_operation: Actual parameter request, response or protocol busy/idle.
native.iol_isdu_address_format: Actual index/subindex encoding selected from index and subindex values.
native.iol_isdu_length_format: Actual short or extended full ISDU length;16 reserved.
